clarification: Filter current numeric candidates for bounded quality, original provenance and no current same-observation conflict before choosing the latest qualified observation. Retain excluded record IDs as blockers without erasing a qualified earlier sample; never update its observed/arrival clocks to a later unqualified reading. A later valid interval crossing the threshold remains UNKNOWN; do not choose older samples by desired outcome.
green_rule: Only change the candidate qualification order, preserve the frozen test/input/expectations and legacy schemas. Source and tool pinned before each remote call.
failure_rule: Every attempt is unique and terminal receipt retained; no automatic retry or overwrite.
durable_set: Declared Git source, literal fixture/test/contract/protocol/authoring tool; manifest, attempt, job and terminal, logs, public input/output. Caches excluded.
